blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled turned to Jonah Sabete-Escamillan this time to fend off Galeries Tower, 25-16, 22-25, 25-17, 25-19, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. Escamillan scattered 18 kills, two blocks, and an ace for a game-high 22 points laced with nine excellent receptions to keep the Chameleons unbeaten early in the conference at 3-0. READ: PVL: Nxled survives Farm Fresh in five-set duel for 2-0 start Nxled had another block party with 14 kill blocks led by MJ Phillips and Escamillan, who had three each.
